theme: An open day at sea — a few bookings waiting on a signal.
greeting: The whole day is yours on the water, Dan — no meetings, no calls. What's waiting isn't on the calendar: a short stack of travel bookings that just need a moment ashore with a signal.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV, before it sells out
needsAttention.detail: Due today: reserve a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week. It's the tightest rental in that market over the holidays, and there's no six-seater in Maine once the Pathfinder heads south — a refundable hold now costs nothing.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat transfers need dry land
needsAttention.detail: The charter ends noon Saturday at Komolac. Pre-book the transfer to the Remisens in Cavtat, confirm an early bag hold before the 3 PM check-in, and arrange a ~5:15 AM checkout and taxi for Sunday's 7:30 flight — all three want doing while you still have a signal, not from the boat.

needsAttention.title: Two unbooked nights when you land
needsAttention.detail: You touch down at TPA Sunday the 20th but don't collect the kids until Tuesday — the nights of the 20th and 21st before the Orlando villa still have nowhere booked. Worth a glance too that the Sept 27–Oct 5 St Pete Airbnb converted from pending before its Sept 18 charge.

needsAttention.title: Book the TPA car outright
needsAttention.detail: This cycle always needed a rental — the Pathfinder can't be in Florida until it's driven down after Oct 18. Book the full-size SUV at TPA for Sept 20–Oct 5 so you're not at a walk-up counter, jet-lagged, on a Sunday.

flagged.title: You're cc'd on a Mercer intro
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano looped Chie Mitsui toward Mercer/Marsh's asset-owner advisory lead — you're only copied and nothing's owed, but it's live in your governance-network orbit.

inbox.noise: Everything else unread is newsletters and promotions — mattresses, market briefs, Maine seafood, a campaign ask.

recipe.title: Borlotti beans with sautéed baby kale
recipe.why: Early autumn brings fresh shell beans and tender greens to the market — a warm, earthy plate for the turning season.

tasks.title: Confirm the Nautilus return transfer to the airport

acts.line: The calendar's empty — you're mid-charter on the Adriatic, and the day belongs to the water.
No meetings to break the sail; the only threads left are a handful of bookings waiting on a dry-land signal.
A shore stop is the moment to close the Cavtat transfers and the Florida-arrival loose ends before connectivity thins again.
